description: Google Year in Search reports trending queries/categories, not absolute monthly search volume or a complete rank of all Pakistan queries. Candidate phrases remain unmeasured.
resolution: Use dated Pakistan-targeted Google Trends/Keyword Planner exports, then PPRI Search Console data post-launch; never derive volume from YIS ranks.

description: PBS Census Table 1 district workbooks are linked in the source index, but their XLSX binaries were not bundled/extracted here. The geography registry contains district names; district populations/density are intentionally not fabricated.
resolution: Fetch official workbooks, preserve originals/checksums, extract all rows and reconcile province totals before enabling district charts.

description: PBS Table 1 reports 93,750,724 urban and 147,748,707 rural in 2023; Key Findings reports 93,884,702 urban and 147,614,729 rural. Both pairs sum to 241,499,431.
resolution: Use a consistent table family for each chart; the inherited canonical observation keeps the Table 1 family and the difference is not averaged.

description: The district registry reflects a PBS Census 2023 listed-district vintage; this is not automatically the current October 2026 district boundary/administration list or a promise that a target of 164 district pages corresponds to the census count.
resolution: Create a separately sourced current-boundary crosswalk with effective dates and parent-child history before claiming a current district total.

description: HIES household income and consumption figures are nominal mean values, not median income. Consumption quintiles are not official poverty thresholds.
resolution: Keep poverty-rate/MPI fields as source-mapped only until the official poverty line, method and table are extracted.

description: Petrol, tariffs, exchange rates and gold quotes have different sources/frequencies. Gold prices are market quotes rather than one government-set nationwide rate.
resolution: Attach date/effective date, product, category, unit, provider and official-versus-market flag; update dynamic pages before publication.

description: HIES is a survey and uses a different universe/design from the Census. Household size, income and access measures are not Census counts.
resolution: Preserve source round, age threshold, universe, denominator and urban/rural definition with every observation.

description: Some HIES SDG values were taken from a compact official dashboard summary; their exact denominator/indicator phrasing must be checked in the full report before explanatory page text is written.
resolution: Use the official source table and keep improved water source separate from water within premises and safely managed water.

description: GDP, debt and sector-growth figures can be provisional, rounded or revised after the Economic Survey publication.
resolution: Retain as-of date and status; refresh only from the newest PBS/Finance Division release and preserve revision history.

description: Many query variants can express the same need; one page per keyword would create thin or duplicated pages.
resolution: Use query_clusters.csv and page_catalog.csv as canonical routing authority; only index when a complete, sourced answer is ready.

description: PSER, Asaan Karobar Card, laptop scheme, exam result and e-challan queries can be time-sensitive. Their appearance as trends does not verify programme status or eligibility.
resolution: Check the live official portal/notification and record checked date before publishing current instructions or deadlines.

description: Wikipedia and international sources may use different reference years/definitions than Pakistani primary sources.
resolution: Use for orientation and cross-checking; publish key figures with official primary source citations.
